page.lede: What I am *currently* doing, thinking, reading. Updated when something actually changes — not on a schedule. Inspired by [Derek Sivers' /now page](https://nownownow.com/about).

sections.label: Writing
sections.body:
*The Signal* is published on Kindle. Recursion continues in the field at [/signal](../signal/), which is live at v0.1.

*Organizational Frequency* is published, with a print edition to follow.

sections.label: Building
sections.body:
*GoodSpace AI* — the platform that lives at the heart of the *Organizational Frequency* doctrine. Currently scaling the product around intelligent discovery rather than resume-matching. Half a million matches and counting.

Quietly: the backend that will eventually power the Studio. A small one, built deliberately.

sections.label: Running
sections.body: A private five-week cohort for Harvard OPM alumni — the working group already on the WhatsApp list. This is not a public course. Alumni who already have access enter the workspace at [/ai-business-leaders/login](/ai-business-leaders/login).

sections.label: Reading
sections.body:
Currently:

- *The Master and His Emissary*, Iain McGilchrist — re-reading
- *Working in Public*, Nadia Eghbal
- *The Beginning of Infinity*, David Deutsch
- Notes from the last decade of *Edge.org* Annual Questions

The shelf rotates slowly. Most of what compounds is what gets re-read.

sections.label: Thinking about
sections.body:
Three open questions at the moment:

1. **What changes about a book when the reader is structurally interacted with by the book?** This is what The Signal is. We do not yet know what to call this category.

2. **What is the right shape of an AI-mediated cognitive instrument?** Different from a chatbot. Different from a coach. Closer to a *fixed instrument with adaptive depth.*

3. **What does 'compounding' actually require?** I have written about this. I am still learning what I wrote.

sections.label: Recent
sections.body:
*The Signal* is published. The field at [/signal](../signal/) is live at v0.1. The Studio editing room is operational across six surfaces — videos, notebook, books, prompts, the rotating *Now* line, and a progress dashboard.

The Notebook is empty for now. Watch has two shorts from May 22.

sections.label: Not doing
sections.body: *Not* on the social media optimisation treadmill. *Not* on the conference circuit. *Not* taking sales calls. *Not* writing another business book about AI. The discipline of refusal is the practice this site is built around.
